defmodule MyApp.Gate do
  alias MyApp.Admission

  def check(x) do
    MyApp.Admission.admit(x)
  end

  def quick(x), do: MyApp.Admission.admit(x)

  def guarded(x)
      when is_integer(x),
      do: MyApp.Admission.admit(x)

  def spread(x),
    do:
      MyApp.Admission.admit(x)

  def guarded_block(x)
      when is_integer(x) do
    MyApp.Admission.admit(x)
  end

  def multi(:skip), do: :skip

  def multi(x) do
    Admission.admit(x)
  end

  defp private(x) do
    if x, do: MyApp.Admission.admit(x), else: nil
  end

  def one_line(x) do MyApp.Admission.admit(x) end
  def after_one_line(x) do
    MyApp.Admission.admit(x)
  end

  def twice(x), do: MyApp.Admission.admit(MyApp.Admission.admit(x))

  def with_default(x, opts \\ []) do
    MyApp.Admission.admit({x, opts})
  end

  def private_user(x), do: private(x)
end
